Name: Pink-Haired Haley
Author: flowercrownjml
Description:
[size=3][size=5]💖[/size]
Over 10 years ago I [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/pink-haired-haley.3452/]published a simple mod[/url] for version 1.0 to make Haley's hair pink. A decade later I decided to try updating it![/size]

This mod is a simple recolor that gives Haley pink hair in all overworld sprites and portraits, as well as the 8-heart event photos, emoji, and "Haley's Portrait" furniture item.
It also makes her skirt yellow instead of pink. There [i]can[/i] be too much pink.

I made this updated version for myself for the novelty of it, but decided it'd be fun to upload it again. It's not perfect but I had fun. I haven't really played much since the game's original release, either, so updating this kind of reflects my own experience in a weird way.

[size=4]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6+
Requires [url=https://smapi.io/]Stardew Modding API[/url][/size][size=4]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url][/size]
[size=3]Install instructions: Extract inner folder to [font=Courier New].../Stardew Valley/Mods/ [/font](as any other SMAPI mod)[/size]
[size=2]
Technical notes on changes:
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Portraits, overworld sprites, and event photos are full replacements and override other mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]"Haley's Portrait" and the emoji are partial replacements and hopefully leave other sprites in the tilesheets untouched.[/size]
[/list][size=2]
Screenshot credits:[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Custom dialogue mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28046]Haley Ever After[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=2]Custom UI mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25349]Lowkey Spring Interface Recolor[/url][/size]
[/list]
For other unrelated people's mods I found that make Haley's hair pink, see also:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2342]Pink Haired Haley by Mitokandria[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36977]Rainbow Haley by Dimando2007[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20140]NoodleJubblies' Pink Hair for SO-SCA Haley[/url]﻿ which is for another mod I don't use but looks so good that I might have to consider it.

Shoutouts to women. Thank you women
[size=5]💖[/size]
